To resolve this issue, you should ensure that the `_constructor` method is correctly implemented and imported in the `pandas.core.arrays.datetimelike.DatetimeArray` class. This will allow the `count()` method to create new instances of the same type when needed without encountering the `AttributeError`.

Suggested fix:

```
pandas.core.arrays.datetimelike.DatetimeArray._constructor
```
